# Utakata-UI

> An AI-native React and TypeScript UI framework built on Base UI and Lism CSS.

## Documentation

- [Project overview and usage](README.md)
- [Agent implementation guide](skills/utakata-ui/SKILL.md)
- [React package exports](packages/react/src/index.ts)
- [Component manifest](packages/react/src/manifest.ts)
- [MCP server tools](packages/mcp/src/server.ts)

## Principles

- Use the component manifest as the source for supported variants, defaults, composition, and accessibility contracts.
- Preserve Base UI behavior and compose Field and Dialog from their documented parts.
- Use semantic HTML, Lism CSS, and CSS custom properties; do not invent component props.
- Verify generated UI with keyboard interaction and accessibility checks.
